notes: The added tests prove that paginate keeps the trailing partial page: five items at two per page yield [[1, 2], [3, 4], [5]] and one item at three per page yields [[1]], while the pre-existing tests confirm that evenly dividing lists, the empty list and the rejection of a page size below one are unchanged. A subprocess test drives `python -m pager --size 2` with five lines and checks that all five are printed as three blank-line-separated pages. With the implementation restored to the base commit the range in paginate stops before the last partial page, so the new tests fail.
